text:
Are you a QA Automation Engineer with strong TypeScript and Playwright experience looking for a long-term, fully remote opportunity in fintech? Join a fast-moving project focused on modern payment and disbursement workflows, where you’ll help build robust automation coverage and ensure the quality and reliability of a high-impact financial platform. 

We’re looking for someone with 4+ years of QA Automation experience; fintech experience and Russian language skills are highly preferred, with availability to collaborate during EST hours.
 Responsibilities:

• Design, build, and maintain automated testing frameworks across web applications, APIs, backend services, and third-party integrations.

• Develop and execute unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end automated test suites to ensure system reliability, stability, and overall quality.

• Create and maintain automated tests for complex workflows, edge cases, data integrity, and state transitions across services.

• Integrate and manage automated testing within CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.

• Conduct performance, scalability, and load testing across core services and infrastructure to identify bottlenecks and reliability risks.

• Identify, document, and track bugs, performance issues, and system weaknesses while partnering closely with engineering, DevOps, and product teams to improve QA processes, automation coverage, and testing standards.

 Requirements

• 4+ years of experience in QA Automation, including designing, building, and maintaining automated testing frameworks.

• Strong proficiency in TypeScript for developing automation scripts and test frameworks, with hands-on experience with Playwright.

• Strong understanding of testing best practices, test strategy, software development lifecycles, and modern QA methodologies.

• Hands-on experience working with CI/CD pipelines and containerized environments such as Docker.

• Previous experience in fintech, financial services, payments, banking, or other financial technology environments is highly preferred, particularly where accuracy, reliability, security, and data integrity are critical.

• Strong verbal English communication skills, excellent attention to detail, and availability to work and collaborate effectively with distributed teams during EST (Eastern Standard Time) hours.
